title: Document Review with Unsiloed and TypeSafe Jev
summary: Unsiloed AI introduces a type-safe approach to document review using Jev, enabling developers to build more reliable AI-powered document processing applications with strong type guarantees and reduced runtime errors.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of building unreliable, error-prone document review AI systems by providing type-safe abstractions for better code quality and predictability.
why_valuable: Type-safe document processing reduces bugs and makes AI-powered document review more maintainable and trustworthy for enterprise applications.
